# 番大悲神呪

**ID:** T1063
**Volume:** T20
**Category:** 密教部類
**Original Category:** 密教部
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1063

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Yuán-dynasty alternative recension of the **Mahā-karuṇā-dhāraṇī** under the rubric *fān* 番 — "foreign," conventionally referring to Tibetan or, more broadly, Inner-Asian Indic-derived sources rendered through a Mongol-period translation apparatus. The *zhòu*-text uses a distinctive Yuán transcription system featuring densely-clustered 二合 ("two-conjoined") consonant graphs, a high frequency of 啞 / 葛 / 諦 / 拶 / 麻 / 哩 / 斡 syllabaries — all features of the Yuán-dynasty Tibetan-Sanskrit transcription apparatus standardised under the Mongol *Yìjīng* program led by the Sa-skya hierarchs.

**Abstract**

Comparison with the earlier Tang and Sòng *Mahā-karuṇā-dhāraṇī* recensions ([KR6j0260](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0260), [KR6j0262](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0262), [KR6j0265](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0265), [KR6j0269](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0269)) shows the *Fān dàbēi shénzhòu* to be an independent translation from a Tibetan-derived (or Sanskrit-via-Tibetan) source rather than a Chinese editorial revision. The phonological apparatus matches the Yuán Tibetan-Sanskrit *zhìyīn* 直音 ("direct phonology") method documented in the *Mèngwén zhēnzhū* [蒙文真珠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Titles/%E8%92%99%E6%96%87%E7%9C%9F%E7%8F%A0) and other Yuán transcription manuals. The text is anonymous; the translator is sometimes provisionally identified in modern reference works with Yuán-period Tibetan-trained Buddhist masters at the Mongol court (e.g. **Pa-chos-pa** / **'Phags-pa** [八思巴](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%AB%E6%80%9D%E5%B7%B4) circles), but no firm colophonic attribution survives. As an independent witness to the *Mahā-karuṇā-dhāraṇī* that bypasses the Tang transmission altogether, it is of considerable value for reconstructing the Sanskrit *Vorlage*.

CANWWW (T20N1063) cross-references [KR6j0260](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0260) and the other *Sahasrabhuja* recensions.
